pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Left leg, printed face towards you. Use 3V3 so the output stays under 3.3 V

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: Right leg. About VCC/2 with no magnet, moves up or down with field polarity. To an ADC pin (prefer ADC1: GPIO 32 to 39)

sources.title: Honeywell SS49E datasheet
sources.section: Pin 1 Vs, 2 ground, 3 output; ratiometric output, null at about Vs/2
